steps.note: Remove any leftover (invalid) index of the same name from an earlier failed attempt. Concurrent drop: no lock that blocks the app's reads or writes. No-op today (only orders_pkey exists).
steps.sql: DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF EXISTS orders_customer_id_idx;

steps.note: Build the index without blocking traffic. CONCURRENTLY takes only a SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE lock, so INSERTs and SELECTs keep running during the build (~10M rows, 751 MB table). Alone in its own step because it cannot run inside a transaction block.
steps.sql: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY orders_customer_id_idx ON orders (customer_id);

steps.note: Check the index finished valid and ready; fail the plan loudly if not (a failed concurrent build leaves an INVALID index the planner ignores).
steps.sql: DO $$ BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_index WHERE indexrelid = 'public.orders_customer_id_idx'::regclass AND indisvalid AND indisready) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'orders_customer_id_idx is not valid'; END IF; END $$;
